known_limitations: No Gemini credentials were configured, so no live generation latency or live token usage was measured.
The frontend defaults to documented demo mode unless NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=false is set before build/start; production deployment must set this explicitly.
A bare Clause 1.3.1 query retrieves the requested clause at rank 3, and a bare Table 1 query is cross-standard ambiguous. Frozen ranking and exact-identifier behavior were intentionally not changed.
The Stage 4.4 dataset still contains one known RERANKING_ERROR; Stage 5.1 did not change ranking.
Services has no direct source entity payload; it hands users to the Sources context rather than opening a source drawer itself.
The shared source UI accepts any absolute http(s) URL supplied by a trusted backend. Current corpus URLs are all HTTPS BIS URLs, but there is no frontend hostname allow-list.
Real-model TestClient execution can hang in this sandbox's worker-thread transport; the actual Uvicorn HTTP boundary completed correctly and was used for production-path validation.
The test suite reports a Starlette TestClient deprecation warning recommending httpx2.
Latency is CPU/runtime dependent; values are observations and were not used to alter models, thresholds, ranking, or retrieval configuration.
